visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a woman's face as she aggressively bites the cheek of a tabby cat she is holding. The cat appears slightly squished but calm. The background is a simple indoor room with curtains. (2) A montage of fast-paced cuts follows: hands pinching a cat's fluffy cheeks, a fist punching a yellow circular plushie, hands vigorously petting a golden retriever's head, and a man bending over to bite the rear end of a white cat. The lighting is bright and indoor. (3) A cartoon male host with blue hair and a gray t-shirt appears against a dark blue background, gesturing with his hands as he speaks. A graphic of a brain appears with small text bubbles, followed by an orange character emoji showing extreme emotion with tears and hearts. (4) The final phase shows more close-ups of a round white hamster in a hand, a wide-eyed kitten, and a finger repeatedly poking a squishy white character toy. Yellow and white text overlays remain prominent throughout.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 維維維. [Slogan]: 可愛侵略. [Slogan]: 想捏爆可愛的東西?. (2) [Subtitle]: 你會這樣嗎?. [Subtitle]: 看到可愛的貓貓. [Subtitle]: 或狗狗. [Subtitle]: 或娃娃. [Subtitle]: 就忍不住想亂揉. [Subtitle]: 抓一抓. [Subtitle]: 甚至咬它?. (3) [Subtitle]: 放心, 你不是變態. [Subtitle]: 這叫做可愛侵略. [Subtitle]: 研究發現. [Subtitle]: 至少一半的大人都會這樣. [Subtitle]: 為什麼會想欺負可愛的東西啊?. (4) [Variety]: 冷靜點啦. [Subtitle]: 就像一個人太過高興時哭了. [Subtitle]: 太過生氣反而發笑. [Subtitle]: 大腦為了不讓你笑死或氣死. [Subtitle]: 所產生的反向行為. [Subtitle]: 同樣當被可愛到情緒過載後. [Subtitle]: 大腦為了幫你冷靜. [Subtitle]: 就會想亂揉. [Subtitle]: 對可愛的東西宣洩. [Subtitle]: 太可愛我受不了了的情緒啦.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A fast-tempo, upbeat electronic synth track begins immediately. A clear male voice starts narrating with a high energy, friendly tone. (2) A muffled 'thud' sound occurs as the plushie is punched, synchronized with the music's beat. (3) A bright 'ding' sound effect triggers as the concept '可愛侵略' is mentioned, followed by a 'pop' sound when text bubbles appear on screen. The narrator's pitch rises when asking the question '為什麼?'. (4) The background music remains continuous and bright until the very end, with the male voice maintaining a steady, fast pace, concluding with a light cartoonish 'bounce' SFX.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To explain the psychological phenomenon of 'Cute Aggression' (the urge to squeeze cute things) in a relatable and easy-to-understand manner for social media audiences.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-density editing and vibrant colors make this an effective educational short. The use of cats and hamsters maximizes visual appeal for clustering with 'Pets' or 'Psychology' content.
